[RLOW.8.1.1] Series declarations are not directly observable
runtime constructs. The compiler resolves the declaration's
observation lines (per [LSER.13])
into one or more **runtime backend atoms** per
[RDSC.5a], keyed as [RDSC.5a.8.1] states. Identity-slot resolution
follows [LSER.7.6.1] — the `by:` block-option, or the schema's
declared identity where it has one, with no by-name default;
schema-name resolution follows [LSER.7.7] (unique-required
scoping).
